narrative: 通过一件物体离开。结尾段落、一个向城市敞开的心灵、一个通过窗户变成街道的房间、一个瞳孔、一扇带栏杆的窗框：“缺席”本身可以成为戏剧的中心。
这个效果是视点抛弃了这个人，而不仅仅是经过一个障碍物。一次从未真正进入物质内部的变焦拉远不是这个镜头。
这件物体必须像一条隧道一样占据整个画面。
how: 把房间、物体和室外空间当作同一个空间问题来设计。可拆卸的屏障、支撑装置的交接，或后期合成。
编排好室外的动作和画外音，以便在摄影机移开视线时依然能承载这个事件。提示词：Through-object-out from [Subject], the camera exiting via an object into a wider world, the interior becoming exterior.
when: 用它通过一件物体离开一个人，进入更宽广的空间。不要用一次普通的拉镜头来冒充传送门效果。
vs: 穿物进入（Through Object In）是抵达。航拍拉远（Aerial Pullback）则通过不断升高离开，直到地理空间占据主导，不需要借助道具作为隧道。
穿物而出则需要以这件物体作为出口。
examples_film: 《过客》（The Passenger）临近结尾处的酒店房间镜头，朝一扇带栏杆的窗户移动并穿越而出，随后回望。《超时空接触》（Contact）和《生命之树》（The Tree of Life）用比例和物质层面的“出口”作为一种揭示手段。
语法要点：通过一件物体离开，内部变成外部。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是变焦拉远，或者摇臂上升。破绽在于：世界变大了，却从未有任何物体作为通道占满画面。
解决办法：先让这件物体占满镜头，真正穿越它，然后才是更宽广的世界。

faq.q: 电影中的穿物而出（Through Object Out）是什么？
faq.a: 穿物而出是一个移动的视点，通过穿越一件物体离开主体，进入一个更宽广的空间，内部由此变成外部。

faq.q: 穿物而出（Through Object Out）与穿物进入（Through Object In）的区别
faq.a: 穿物进入通过一件道具进入，抵达这个人身上。穿物而出则通过一件道具离开，可以把这个人抛给一个更宽广的世界。

faq.q: 什么时候该用穿物而出（Through Object Out）？
faq.a: 用它来表现结尾段落，以及通过一件物体离开的比例揭示。不要用一次没有传送门效果的普通拉镜头来代替。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写穿物而出（Through Object Out）的提示词？
faq.a: 从主体开始，穿越一件具体的物体离开，抵达一个更宽广的空间。示例：Through-object-out from [Subject], the camera exiting via an object into a wider world.

narrative: Leave through a thing. Endings, a mind opening onto a city, a room that becomes a street by way of a window, a pupil, a barred frame: absence can be the dramatic center.
The effect is the viewpoint abandoning the person, not merely passing an obstacle. A zoom out that never enters matter is not this shot.
The object must occupy the frame as a tunnel.
how: Stage room, object, and exterior as one spatial problem. Removable barrier, support transfer, or composite.

Choreograph exterior action and offscreen sound to carry the event if the camera looks away. Prompt: Through-object-out from [Subject], the camera exiting via an object into a wider world, the interior becoming exterior.
when: Use it to leave a person through a thing into a larger space. Do not use a plain pull-out and claim a portal.
vs: Through Object In arrives. Aerial Pullback leaves by gaining altitude until geography wins, without needing a prop as tunnel.
Through-object-out needs the object as the exit.
examples_film: The Passenger 's late hotel-room shot moves toward and beyond a barred window, then looks back. Contact and The Tree of Life use exits of scale and matter as revelation.
Grammar: leave through a thing, interior becoming exterior.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a zoom out or a crane-up. The tell: the world enlarges but no object ever fills the frame as a passage.
The fix: occupy the lens with the object, travel through it, then the wider world.

faq.q: What is Through Object Out in film?
faq.a: Through object out is a moving viewpoint that leaves a subject by traveling out through an object into a larger space, interior becoming exterior.

faq.q: Through Object Out vs Through Object In
faq.a: Through-object-in enters via a prop and arrives on the person. Through-object-out exits via a prop and can abandon the person to a wider world.

faq.q: When should I use Through Object Out?
faq.a: Use it for endings and scale reveals that leave through a thing. Do not use a plain pull-out with no portal.

faq.q: How do I prompt Through Object Out for AI image or video?
faq.a: Start on the subject, travel out through a named object, arrive in a larger space. Example: Through-object-out from [Subject], the camera exiting via an object into a wider world.
